sentences.sentence: I want to tell you what I would do if I met the Sand Fairy.
I would wish for magic soccer shoes that always score a goal.
I would love to have a pet dinosaur.
I would ask for something amazing like a flying car.
What would you like to wish for?
With magic soccer shoes, I might score 100 goals in one game.
I would take my dinosaur to the park.
I would be able to fly anywhere in the world.
